doc.description: Lets several simulated aircraft talk to each other and to the GCS with PPRZLINK v2 over UDP: maps the ports of each agent to its aircraft id.
doc.usage: usage: pprzlink_proxy.py [-h] [--gcs GCS_CONF] [--ac ACS_CONF] [--addr ADDRESS] [--script SCRIPT] [-v]

option.description: AC configuration with format ID:[IP:]PORT_OUT:PORT_IN (multiple possible)
